regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 43". Crystal Mountain and Mt. Baker follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Thursday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 36". Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow. Winter Storm Warning at Grand Targhee from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Jay Peak is forecast for about 31". Mont-Sainte-Anne and Whiteface follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jay Peak Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Jay Peak from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 27", 25" of it Tuesday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Monday night and Tuesday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 29". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 26". Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Monday night and Tuesday.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 25", 13" of it Thursday. RED Mountain and Fernie follow.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 23", 15" of it Tuesday. Solitude and Park City follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 26", 17" of it Saturday. Vail and Arapahoe Basin follow. Winter Weather Advisory at Steamboat from Friday to Sunday.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 18", 9" of it Thursday. SilverStar and Sun Peaks follow.

regions.title: Canadian Rockies
regions.text: Sunshine Village is forecast for about 7". Lake Louise and Norquay follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Sunshine Village Thursday.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
